LOOK: Smoldering areas of the Navotas Sanitary Landfill were still observed as of 8:00 p.m. on Saturday, April 18, more than a week since the fire started.

The Obando MDRRMO reminded residents near the area to stay alert and wear face masks if smoke is present in their communities. (📷: Obando MDRRMO) | via Trixee Rosel
